def find_runs(flags_1d, minlen):
    """list of (start,end) inclusive of runs of True with length>=minlen"""
    runs = []
    n = len(flags_1d); i = 0

        if flags_1d[i]:

            i = j+1

    return runs

def join_runs(runs, maxgap):
    """merge runs separated by <=maxgap non-hot days (gap days belong to event)"""
    if not runs: return []
    merged = [runs[0][:]]
    for s,e in runs[1:]:
        if s - merged[-1][1] - 1 <= maxgap and s - merged[-1][1] - 1 >= 1:
            merged[-1][1] = e

    return merged

# correct smoothing: 366-element array (days 1..366), wrap modulo 366
def smooth31(pre):           # pre: (367,60,60), index 0 unused
    p = pre[1:367]           # (366,60,60): index i -> day i+1
    out = np.zeros_like(p)
    for off in range(-15,16):
        out += np.roll(p, off, axis=0)
    out /= 31.0
    full = np.full_like(pre, np.nan)
    full[1:367] = out
    return full

thr_s, clim_s = smooth31(thr), smooth31(clim)
print("smoothed thr/clim finite on sea cells, all 366 doys:",
      bool(np.isfinite(thr_s[1:][:, sea]).all()), bool(np.isfinite(clim_s[1:][:, sea]).all()))

    runs=[]; n=len(f); i=0
    while i < n:
        if f[i]:

            while j+1<n and f[j+1]: j+=1
            if j-i+1>=minlen: runs.append([i,j])
            i=j+1
        else: i+=1
    return runs

def join_runs(runs, maxgap):
    if not runs: return []
    m=[runs[0][:]]
    for s,e in runs[1:]:

import numpy as np, pandas as pd, xarray as xr, json, os

def find_runs(f_, minlen):
    runs=[]; n=len(f_); i=0
    while i < n:
        if f_[i]:
            j=i
            while j+1<n and f_[j+1]: j+=1
            if j-i+1>=minlen: runs.append([i,j])
            i=j+1
        else: i+=1
    return runs
def join_runs(runs, maxgap):
    if not runs: return []
    m=[runs[0][:]]
    for s,e in runs[1:]:
        gap=s-m[-1][1]-1
        if 1<=gap<=maxgap: m[-1][1]=e
        else: m.append([s,e])
    return m
